editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test from NMLS. Covers federal mortgage laws, uniform state content, and loan origination.
editorial.overview: The SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test, certified by NMLS, covers federal mortgage laws, uniform state content, general mortgage knowledge, loan origination activities, and ethics. This assessment evaluates candidates seeking state-licensed mortgage loan originator status across participating jurisdictions as part of the official licensing and regulatory framework with an exam price of 110.0 dollars.
editorial.who_should_take: Individuals seeking state-licensed mortgage loan originator status through NMLS must take this assessment to demonstrate their knowledge of mortgage regulations, state content, and ethical standards.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the content outline across all five domains carefully in order to prepare for the test. Focus heavily on federal mortgage laws, uniform state content, general mortgage knowledge, loan origination procedures, and ethical standards. Candidates must answer based on current standards for this examination.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain broadly covers federal mortgage-related laws including the Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act, the Equal Credit Opportunity Act, and the Truth in Lending Act regulations for all candidates.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain widely encompasses general mortgage knowledge including qualified and non-qualified mortgage programs, diverse loan products, and important terms used throughout the entire mortgage industry for all practicing loan originators.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive fully prepared for a 190-minute test with an appointment length of 225 minutes. Ensure you understand all formatting rules and answer based on current standards.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The provided official facts do not specify the exact total question count for the SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test program, though candidates have 190 minutes to complete it.
The passing score required for the SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test is 75%, which is an official percentage mandated by the SAFE Act for all candidates seeking licensure.
The test length for the SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test is 190 minutes, with a total appointment length of 225 minutes scheduled at the testing center.

faq.question_title: What is the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official exam price required to register for the SAFE MLO National Test with Uniform State Test is set at exactly 110.0 dollars for all prospective test takers.
